code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The results show hypoxemia, leukopenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH, D-dimer), and coagulopathy (elevated INR). There is also mild hypoalbuminemia and metabolic acidosis (low CO₂). These findings suggest a severe systemic inflammatory response, possibly due to infection or sepsis, with evidence of hypoxia and risk of coagulopathy. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are strongly recommended.
Provider Organization: Spitalul de Psihiatrie Palazu Mare
